verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a generic list of payment methods (card, PayPal, Venmo, ACH, Apple Pay) and onboarding methods that reference SSNs and US bank routing numbers. Nothing documents supported onboarding countries, region-specific local payment methods, or local-currency settlement, so there is no coverage map. This is an applicable axis for a payments platform, but the pack offers no evidence that Rainforest delivers it.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket
